snippet.title: Machine Party | Official Console Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Machine Party, the violent party game from Mike Klubnika and GDeavid, is coming to consoles! Get ready to put your friendships to the test when Machine Party launches on November 26 on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch.

Contest in a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. A 2–4 player experience where you and your friends will face high-stakes situations to prove whose life is worth the most.

Features of Machine Party
- A collection of uniquely violent party games 
- Support for 2 - 4 players 
- An industrial soundtrack by Alex Peipman
- Customize your test subject
- Multiple devious ways of screwing your friends over

Some games will make you competitively eat peas in secrecy, others will make you smoke cigarettes at lightning speed, there’s a whole array of twisted challenges that await. If you believe you are best suited to shoot your friends in the head with a sniper rifle then this game is for you. 

Wishlist on Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10020086
Wishlist on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/machine-party/9ngjsb0wdwrp
